title: Agentic Ensemble with Vision-Language Models for Visual Anomaly Detection
abstract: arXiv:2610.28560v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Visual anomaly detection aims to detect abnormal objects, while anomaly samples are often scarce during model training. Assembling multiple pretrained detectors can help by leveraging their transferable image scores and anomaly maps. However, most existing ensemble methods apply fixed fusion rules over saved predictions which struggle when pretrained detectors clearly disagree due to different training objectives, priors, and visual representations. To this end, we design AnomalyAgent, a post-training fusion framework for accurate visual anomaly detection. AnomalyAgent aligns heterogeneous scores and maps, summarizes score- and region-level disagreement, and treats fusion as a finite action-selection problem. It implements two types of actions: 1) score actions that determine how to fuse image-level detector confidence via consensus, robust aggregation, detector weighting, or score-map consistency; 2) map actions that fuse dense anomaly

translated_title: 基于视觉语言模型的智能体集成方法用于视觉异常检测
translated_abstract: 视觉异常检测旨在检测异常物体，而异常样本在模型训练过程中往往非常稀缺。集成多个预训练检测器可以利用其可迁移的图像分数和异常图来改善检测效果。然而，大多数现有的集成方法对已保存的预测结果应用固定的融合规则，当预训练检测器由于不同的训练目标、先验知识和视觉表示而产生明显分歧时，这些方法往往难以奏效。为此，我们设计了AnomalyAgent，一个用于精确视觉异常检测的训练后融合框架。AnomalyAgent对齐异构的分数和异常图，总结分数级别和区域级别的分歧，并将融合视为一个有限动作选择问题。它实现了两类动作：1）分数动作，通过共识机制、鲁棒聚合、检测器加权或分数-异常图一致性来确定如何融合图像级别的检测器置信度；2）图动作，融合密集的异常图。
tldr: 该论文提出AnomalyAgent，一个基于视觉语言模型的训练后融合框架，通过智能体对齐异构检测器的分数与异常图，并将融合建模为有限动作选择问题，从而在预训练检测器之间存在分歧时实现更精确的视觉异常检测。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes AnomalyAgent, a post-training fusion framework based on vision-language models that aligns heterogeneous detector scores and anomaly maps and formulates fusion as a finite action-selection problem, enabling more accurate visual anomaly detection even when pretrained detectors disagree.
